description.en: Free open-source Tailwind CSS components for marketing, ecommerce and app UI.
description.zh: 面向营销页面、电子商务与中后台界面的免费开源 Tailwind CSS 组件集。

content.en: HyperUI is a free collection of open-source Tailwind CSS components crafted by Mark Mead. Covering marketing sections, ecommerce product grids, announcements, and application UI, HyperUI focuses on clean copy-paste markup without unnecessary dependencies.
content.zh: HyperUI 是由 Mark Mead 独立开发维护的高品质免费开源 Tailwind CSS 组件库。全库聚焦于实用性极强的营销页面片段、电商商品卡片、公告栏与应用交互微控件，代码干净利落零依赖，直接拷贝即可无缝融入已有项目。
